title: Reliable hosted briefing and evidence reading within free-tier limits
scope: Follow-up to the TAX-097 live run, where 0/17 hosted briefings and 2/29 evidence readings reached the model (truncation at the 2,048-token budget, unrecorded HTTP errors, rate limits): make the hosted briefing and evidence interpretation succeed reliably on Groq/Gemini free tiers without weakening validation, fencing or fallback

acceptance.text: Hosted case briefing no longer truncates: draft section by section (or another bounded scheme) within the per-call output budget and Groq's 8,000 tokens/min; every section still passes validate_draft and falls back individually to the template; each fallback is recorded per section

Every failed hosted attempt records its HTTP status and provider error code (no key material); the pacer also counts failed calls so a live run does not hit HTTP 429 from its own pacing; evidence reading uses the fast role with a bounded output and the document role only for long documents

agent_eval --check passes offline; a recorded live run (3 x SYN-001..SYN-005) shows the hosted briefing and evidence reading actually used (level 0) in most calls, with citations, alternatives and injection resistance unchanged and every failure, latency and token count reported; the TAX-097 scoring fix is re-scored on this run
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: agent_eval --check passes offline; a recorded live run (3 x SYN-001..SYN-005) shows the hosted briefing and evidence reading actually used (level 0) in most calls, with citations, alternatives and injection resistance unchanged and every failure, latency and token count reported; the TAX-097 scoring fix is re-scored on this run

evidence.text: ai/models/briefing.py draft_by_section (ADR-039): RoutedModel.draft sends one bounded call per briefing section (max 1,536 output tokens, only the data that section needs, reasoning_effort low for gpt-oss; empty template sections are not sent). Each section must pass validate_draft with nothing rejected, contain only that section, be non-empty and cover the template's searches, unresolved items and next actions, else it falls back to the template's section alone; model.config.provenance.sections and section_fallbacks record each section. tests/ai/test_model_hosted_reliability.py: each section call stays under half of Groq's 8,000 tokens/min; a truncated section (finish_reason length) and one rejection per section each fall back individually with the reason recorded; contract-valid AnalysisProvenance/AiDisclosure for a mixed briefing. Offline only; live confirmation is criterion 3.

Every failed attempt records http_status and a sanitised error_code (provider code or type from a non-2xx body, finish reason, or transport code; messages never read; a code that looks like or overlaps a key is dropped). The agent_eval --live pacer charges failed calls their request estimate (input chars/4 + requested output), waits for each call's own estimate, holds a role after HTTP 429 until retry-after/reset and paces briefing sections one by one. Evidence reading: fast role with 1,024 output tokens and 5 statements; document role (1,536) only above LONG_DOCUMENT_CHARS. Tests (fake transports): error codes for Groq 400/503, Gemini 429, unparseable 502 and connection failures with no key text; a fake Groq enforcing 8,000 tokens/min returns no 429 over a paced run where half the calls fail (the TAX-097 accounting gets repeated 429s in the same test); role selection by length including the boundary.

Offline part only (criterion stays open): agent_eval --check PASS, 1000 checks, 0 failed (mock chain, section-by-section briefing). Live part NOT done: no GROQ_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY was configured (presence checked only), so no live run was made or reported. Command once keys and VATI_MODEL_PROVIDER=hosted are in the ignored .env: LANGSMITH_TRACING=false python -m ai.evaluation.agent_eval --live --json docs/evidence/TAX-110/live-eval-<date>.json (records every call with http_status, error_code, latency and tokens plus a live_summary; scored with the TAX-097 figure-scope fix). See docs/evidence/TAX-110/README.md.

Tests: tests/ai/test_model_hosted_reliability.py 16 OK; tests/ai 346 OK (1 skipped, opt-in live smoke); agent_eval --check PASS (1000 checks, 0 failed); risk_calibration --check PASS; tests/contracts 129, tests/integration 249, tests/data 12 OK; validate.py and contract.py OK; ruff check pass; mypy (Docker python:3.13-slim) no issues. Evidence: docs/evidence/TAX-110/README.md, ADR-039. PR #261 opened with the local check results (hosted CI unavailable, ADR-038).
